t: You're standing on Charles II Street, a street in St James's, in the City of Westminster. It takes its name from Charles II, who was King of Scotland from 1649 until 1651, and then King of England, Scotland and Ireland from the Restoration of the monarchy in 1660 until his death in 1685. That's the connection here: the street carries the name of the king who came back to the throne. I can't tell you much more about the street itself, so take a look around at St James's.
